text:
Follow-up hardening after review of my own fix. The absence branch originally fell back to Vector.empty on an unparseable response and marked every requested job NotFound -- which, if squeue refuses a mixed query wholesale, would report still-running jobs as absent. That is a fabricated answer, exactly the class of statement this library exists to avoid.

Absence is now claimed only for jobs the response accounts for: a readable response is trusted fully (including an empty job list); an unreadable response is trusted only when a single job was named, since it is then the rejected one; an unreadable response naming several jobs yields squeue-absence-ambiguous as a ParseFailed. Correct under either real squeue behaviour.

Evidence: SlurmCliSchedulerSuite now covers single-job absence, unreadable multi-job (ambiguous, never absent), readable multi-job empty queue (all absent), mixed partial response, and unrecognized failure staying InvocationFailed. cli 32/32; full gate green. docs/compatibility.md states the rule and that the mixed case is not yet capture-established.
